addr: 3rd Floor, 546, Chinmaya Mission Hospital Rd, above RBL Bank, opposite Motherhood hospital, Stage 1, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560038, India

rev.t: Tried bouldering for the first time at Equilibrium Climbing Station in Indiranagar and it was an amazing experience! …

Super nice bouldering gym - it's small but the route setting is great and the training area is well equipped with all the basics. The staff is super friendly and the toilets and showers are clean. Will definitely come back when I'm in Bangalore again!

Had a great experience at Equilibrium Climbing Station. The place is well maintained and beginner-friendly. A special thanks to coach Thazzathoibi for her patience, clear guidance, and encouragement—it really made climbing enjoyable and confident for me. Highly recommended!
